title: The Toy Boat
note: b384 — first use of 'tug', boat's hullKey/chipped/reflection/sailKey options, 'motion_arc'.

pages.brief: Ned the duckling holding up a small wooden toy boat with both flippers, presenting it to the reader with enormous pride.
pages.alt: Ned the duckling holds up a small wooden toy boat with both flippers, presenting it to the reader with enormous pride.

pages.brief: Close on the boat itself: pillar-box red hull, white sail, chipped paint showing it is well loved. Beautiful object detail.
pages.alt: A close view of the boat itself: a pillar-box red hull, a white sail, and chipped paint showing it is well loved.

pages.brief: Ned crouched at the pond edge lowering the boat onto the water, tongue out with concentration, ripples spreading from it.
pages.alt: Ned crouches at the pond edge, lowering the boat onto the water with his tongue out in concentration as ripples spread from it.

pages.brief: The boat sailing out across the open water, small and upright, its reflection beneath it. Wide calm pond, lots of water.
pages.alt: The boat sails out across the open water, small and upright with its reflection beneath it, on a wide calm pond.

pages.brief: Moss arriving at the bank with his own toy — a squat wooden tug — held awkwardly in both paws. Slightly embarrassed, very endearing.
pages.alt: Moss arrives at the bank with his own toy, a squat wooden tug, held awkwardly in both paws — slightly embarrassed, very endearing.

pages.brief: The two toys colliding beside a grey rock, one tipping, a small collision splash. Both owners' faces caught mid-horror on the bank.
pages.alt: The two toys collide beside a grey rock, one tipping with a small splash, while both owners' faces are caught mid-horror on the bank.

pages.brief: Ned with both wings on his head and beak wide open in dismay, close-cropped so the alarm fills the page.
pages.alt: Ned, close-cropped so the alarm fills the page, looks utterly dismayed at what has happened to the toys.

pages.brief: Both boats bobbing upright again, entirely undamaged, one still gently spinning. Relief on the bank behind them.
pages.alt: Both boats bob upright again, entirely undamaged, one still gently spinning, with relief on the bank behind them.

pages.brief: Ned airborne with joy, both wings up, boat clutched to his chest. Water droplets flying. Pure celebration.
pages.alt: Ned is airborne with joy, both wings up, boat clutched to his chest, water droplets flying in pure celebration.

pages.brief: Closing page: the two of them on the bank at golden hour with both boats out drying on the grass, sitting close together. Warm and content.
pages.alt: Closing page: Ned and Moss sit close together on the bank at golden hour, with both boats out drying on the grass, warm and content.
